description: The Settings window is local, bundled content (served via tauri://, never remote) and is the only window trusted with Tauri API access. It gets exactly the app-defined commands it needs: get_server_url/save_server_url (src/store.rs) to read and persist the server URL via the Store plugin, and get_autostart_enabled/set_autostart_enabled (src/autostart.rs, Task 4) to read and toggle whether Guidon Desktop launches at Windows startup via the autostart plugin. `cargo tauri add autostart` scaffolded a separate capabilities/desktop.json granting the raw `autostart:default` permission set to the `main` window - that file was deleted; the grant here is scoped to this window only and to the two app commands above; the plugin's own raw `plugin:autostart|*` commands are not granted anywhere. Do not widen this to the `main` window (see capabilities/default.json) or make it apply globally.
